profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Snowflake | Streamlit in Snowflake (SiS) | Ex-Microsoft Azure & VMware
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer at Snowflake with 10+ years of experience designing and operating cloud-native platforms and distributed systems at scale. Focused on containerized application runtimes, Kubernetes operators, scheduling, observability (OpenTelemetry), reliability, and developer tooling.

experience.role: Senior Software Engineer, Streamlit in Snowflake (SiS)
highlights: Building a fully managed platform that brings Python application runtimes directly to data inside the Snowflake AI Data Cloud.
Working across containerized execution on Snowpark Container Services (SPCS), platform scalability, observability, secure integrations, and developer experience.

experience.role: Senior Software Engineer, Azure Compute & Partner Solutions
highlights: Core contributor to Azure Spot VMs, helping improve cluster utilization from 65% to 95%.
Led ML-based Spot VM replenishment, achieving 4x workload runtime and 5x core consumption, resulting in granted US Patent US12056521B2.
Later led the generic Azure Resource Provider hosting platform powering 10+ third-party Azure Partner Solutions including Datadog, Nginx, Elastic, and Confluent.
Engineered multi-cloud REST adapters for AWS and Azure cloud financial management infrastructure.
Built dependency-safe deletion frameworks for vRealize Business Enterprise.

education.notes: Graduate systems coursework including custom OS kernel development (SBUnix) and network security.
Undergraduate engineering degree and DSAdvisor research published at IEEE LaTiCE 2016.

patent.title: Machine-learning-based replenishment of interruptible workloads in cloud environment
patent.impact: Delivered 4x workload runtime and 5x core consumption while helping drive Azure Spot cluster utilization from 65% to 95%.

publication.title: DSAdvisor: Facilitating Deeper Inquiry in the Data Structures Course

focus_areas: Cloud-native platforms and containerized application runtimes (Snowpark Container Services, Kubernetes operators, scheduling, multi-tenant hosting)
Distributed systems and reliability (Raft consensus, saga orchestration, durable outbox, retry topologies, load simulation)
Observability at scale (OpenTelemetry pipelines, structured logging, Prometheus, Grafana)
Developer tools and security (OAuth 2.0 / OIDC internals, CLI/TUI tools, Bazel, AI coding-agent workflows)

html_sections.overview: Senior Software Engineer · Snowflake · Seattle Sandeep Vishnu Building cloud-native application runtimes and reliable distributed systems at scale. On the Streamlit in Snowflake (SiS) platform team, I work on containerized execution on Snowpark Container Services, scalability, observability, and secure integrations. Previously at Microsoft Azure (Azure Spot VMs & Partner Solutions) and VMware . M.S. in Computer Science from Stony Brook University . GitHub LinkedIn Medium Patent US12056521B2 IEEE LaTiCE Repo Catalog Snowflake · Streamlit in Snowflake Seattle, WA · 11+ yrs
html_sections.experience: Engineering Journey 2015 - Present Snowflake 2022 - Present Senior Software Engineer, Streamlit in Snowflake (SiS) Building a fully managed platform that brings Python application runtimes directly to data inside the Snowflake AI Data Cloud. Microsoft Azure 2019 - 2022 Senior Software Engineer, Azure Compute & Partner Solutions Core contributor to Azure Spot VMs (65% to 95% cluster utilization) and led ML-based Spot replenishment delivering 4x runtime and 5x core consumption ( US12056521B2 ). Later led the generic Resource Provider hosting platform powering 10+ third-party Azure integrations including Datadog, Nginx, Elastic, and Confluent.
